outcome: Maternal serum fibroblast growth factor-23 (FGF-23) levels
cohort: The study included 55 pregnant women undergoing planned cesarean section, categorized into control and gestational hypertensive disease groups, with further subgroups for preeclampsia, eclampsia, gestational hypertension, and presence/absence of fetal growth restriction.
finding: Maternal serum fibroblast growth factor-23 levels were similar between pregnancies with gestational hypertensive disease and normotensive pregnancies overall, but were significantly lower in pregnancies complicated by gestational hypertensive disease with concomitant fetal growth restriction.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during pregnancy leading up to the planned cesarean section.
birth_weight: Birth weight percentile was used to categorize subgroups for fetal growth restriction.
gest_age: Gestational week of delivery was measured, but no specific inclusion criteria for gestational age are mentioned.
